summary: Recovered G000006 and executed the existing deterministic GitHub Actions Chromium harness rather than weakening the candidate to fit the local network sandbox. The workflow was triggered by a semantically inert comment on its own declared push path. Run 36909731917 reached the immutable V11 fixture gate and failed before Chromium because the source bytes at pinned commit 158357fe4e1cb672e4574d9ebe6f317b9418a30f are not strict base64 (binascii.Error: Only base64 data is allowed). No browser assertion was therefore eligible to run, and no product/authority state was promoted.
tests: PASS_CANDIDATE_IDENTITY: workflow accepted exact candidate blob 8f22dd9e0079dab7174eaba784a0d6c793e0ac90.
PASS_PINNED_SOURCE_FETCH: Actions fetched source commit 158357fe4e1cb672e4574d9ebe6f317b9418a30f successfully.
FAIL_IMMUTABLE_FIXTURE_GATE: strict base64 decode failed with binascii.Error: Only base64 data is allowed.
NOT_RUN_CHROMIUM: browser execution correctly remained gated behind immutable source verification.
PASS_NO_AUTHORITY_MUTATION: V11/Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served pointers were not changed.
unresolved: The pinned V11 fixture must be repaired/replaced under source-owner authority before V12 runtime verification can truthfully reach Chromium.
